advisories.title: The inherited clause 'G21 leftover remaining on DR-114' is locationally loose, upstream of this entry
advisories.measurement: The clause is element 9 of anti-lockstep-leftover-join.v3.json doesNot and is quoted twice by the frozen corpus. Read strictly it places the G21 leftover on DR-114, whereas OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING is the leftover-design on g21-leftover-join.v13 (registerRow DR-G21), and the leftovers actually riding DR-114 are OBL-DOCTOR-FX-AUTHORING, OBL-JOIN-FX-AUTHORING, OBL-FC-C1 and OBL-BLK-1..4 per doctor-actor leftover-join.v12 (D-285). D-186's Decision uses the cleaner directional form 'Does not steal G21 leftover from DR-114.'
advisories.whyNotShouldFix: D-300 quotes an adopted artifact verbatim. Rewording it inside this entry would make the entry diverge from the join it records as current, and the prompt forbids remasuring anti-lockstep-leftover-join.v3. The clause is a disclaimer, so no reading of it lets this entry take anything.
advisories.status: travels as honesty work; a candidate tightening for the next anti-lockstep leftover-join successor, not for D-300

decision: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Thirty lines of attack were run and none produced a defect. Every load-bearing claim in the draft was re-derived from primary bytes rather than read back from the draft: both Stage A digests and verdicts, all five advisory identifiers with their per-object member sets including the V3-A-2 status asymmetry, the four predecessor verdicts including the identifier-less Codex observation on v2, the file 08 line 309 column 5 coordinate and its semicolon split, the DR-127 leftover triple against the join's own flags, the sixteen fixtures as citation-only bytes with no platform subdirectory, the ordered-equal platform lists, the D-293 item 8 authoring warrant, the branch endpoints against the D-236 and D-272 exclusions, and the live condition 2, 4 and 5 figures. The strongest available attack was the 'G21 leftover remaining on DR-114' locative; it fails against D-300 because the clause is quoted verbatim from the doesNot list of the very join this entry is forbidden to remasure, and it is recorded as an advisory for a future successor instead.
